meta.name: State-level major crop production 2023-24 and irrigation share
meta.source_org: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, DA&FW, Economics & Statistics Division
meta.limitations: The source lists only the major producing states for each crop, so other states are null. It does not mean zero. Yield rows for foodgrains, pulses and oilseeds cover all states. 2023-24 values come from the 2024-25 edition and can differ from earlier advance estimates. Cotton is in million bales of 170 kg.
meta.method: pdftotext -layout on the PDFs, then regex row parsing. Area, production, yield and irrigation % are copied unchanged. Irrigation share = net irrigated area / net area sown (2022-23) x 100.
